report.scope: Actual separately linked libssf parser, parsed text and node dump in six encodings. Native renderer traces and blank RGBA frames are characterized separately: the pinned FontCache::Create returns NULL after successful CreateFontIndirect. No visible rendering parity is established. WCHAR and UTF-16LE/BOM byte input in borrowed, adopted and copied modes, including mutation of the source after copying; bounded valid fixtures, each side repeated in fresh processes. DirectShow, host playback, other byte encodings and malformed-document coverage remain separate.
